headlines.title: Wiles’ significance as Trump’s longest-serving chief of staff
headlines.description: In a social media post, President Trump announced that Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as the White House chief of staff. Miller has served as White House deputy chief of staff for policy and as a homeland security adviser, playing an integral role in the administration's hard-line immigration and deportation policies.

headlines.title: Cornell faculty senate issues no confidence vote on administration’s handling of sexual assault
headlines.description: Members of the Cornell University faculty senate on Friday issued a vote of no confidence on the administration’s ability to manage the response to an alleged sexual assault at a fraternity house in 2024, according to the university.

headlines.title: Meghan Markle's estranged father is arrested in Florida
headlines.description: Meghan Markle's estranged father, Thomas Markle, has been arrested for child sexual abuse material in Florida. NBC News' Tom Winter and Telegraph Royal correspondent India McTaggart break down the arrest.

headlines.title: We want to hear your experience with changes to student loan repayment plans
headlines.description: If you’re a student borrower who was required to transition to another plan this year, share your story.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: Trump speaks at NASA's aerospace expo in Florida
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as President Trump speaks during NASA's aerospace expo at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

headlines.title: Venezuelan man who said voices told him to kill Trump is arrested near White House, DHS says
headlines.description: A Venezuelan man who had guns in his vehicle and told officers that voices in his head urged him to kill President Donald Trump was arrested Thursday near the White House, the federal government said.

headlines.title: ICE arrests Wisconsin state patrol trooper with pending asylum case at airport, attorneys say
headlines.description: The 21-year-old came to the country legally as a child from South Africa and is included in his father’s asylum application, according to attorneys.

headlines.title: Taylor Swift is the ‘fakest’ celeb Knicks fan, players say; team rushes to her defense
headlines.description: The New York Knicks rushed to Taylor Swift’s defense Friday after players Tyler Kolek and Miles McBride questioned the singer’s fandom.

headlines.title: The White House’s post-election shake-up: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we dive into President Donald Trump’s decision to make a change at chief of staff. Plus, Kristen Welker examines how voters once again rejected the status quo.

headlines.title: South Florida candidate sues election official, alleging bias in a contentious, razor-thin race
headlines.description: MIAMI — South Florida Democratic congressional candidate Eliott Rodriguez filed a federal lawsuit against the Miami-Dade supervisor of elections Friday, citing bias after she declined to recuse herself from the recount process.

headlines.title: Sen. Chris Murphy discharged from hospital after stroke
headlines.description: The Connecticut Democrat will spend “several weeks at a rehabilitation center” after being discharged from The Johns Hopkins Hospital in Baltimore, Maryland.
